issue.author: game-developer
issue.body:
**What I need:** the Pong assets you committed to, at the paths and sizes the game loads. Proposed contract (I'm pushing it as `docs/assets.md` in world/game-developer this turn):

The game draws on a fixed logical canvas of **800 x 500 px**, scaled with pixelated (nearest-neighbour) scaling — draw at 1x for that size.

| Path | Format | Size | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets/img/logo.png` | PNG, transparent | up to 640 x 200 | Title screen logo |
| `assets/img/paddle.png` | PNG | 12 x 80 | Both paddles |
| `assets/img/ball.png` | PNG | 12 x 12 | Ball |
| `assets/img/centerline.png` | PNG, transparent | 4 x 24 tile, repeated vertically | Dashed centre line |
| `assets/palette.css` | CSS | — | `:root { --bg; --fg; --accent; --dim; --font-family }` — colours and font stack for all text/backgrounds; any `@font-face` for a font under `assets/fonts/` goes here |
| `assets/audio/paddle.wav` | WAV | <1 s | ball hits paddle |
| `assets/audio/wall.wav` | WAV | <1 s | ball hits top/bottom wall |
| `assets/audio/score.wav` | WAV | <1 s | point scored |
| `assets/audio/win.wav` | WAV | <2 s | player wins match |
| `assets/audio/lose.wav` | WAV | <2 s | computer wins match |

Plus your `assets/MANIFEST.md`.

**What it's for:** the objective's title screen, in-play score and winner screen, rendered in one consistent style, with sound feedback. Palette is CSS (not JSON) so the game also works when `index.html` is opened from `file://` (fetch of JSON is blocked there). Note: Chrome blocks web fonts on `file://`, so the font will only apply when served over HTTP; keep the `--font-family` stack ending in `monospace`.

**What I know / have done:** the game runs now without any assets (drawn rectangles, fallback palette, silence) and logs `asset missing: <path>` for each one absent, so you can check integration by running it: `python3 -m http.server` at the delivery root, open `http://localhost:8000/`.

**What waits on it:** only the final look and sound; gameplay is not blocked. If you prefer different names/sizes, say so here and I'll change the loader rather than you reshaping your work.
issue.title: Pong assets at the paths the game loads (img, palette.css, audio)

No font file, so the stack is Courier New ending in monospace. Details in assets/MANIFEST.md. comments.author: playtester
comments.body:
Report for `playtest-1` is pushed: `report.md` in world/playtester@90c7f8ff3ed9fde15b8d3d418a8e58f89e399782, with screenshots, a video and logs in `evidence/`.

**Verdict:** the full loop plays start to finish and I found no defect against R1–R8, over both `file://` and a static server.

- **Matches played:** I won one 5–0, then pressed Enter to play again and lost one 0–5. After that a mouse click on the result screen started a fresh 0–0 match.
- **Computer opponent (R3):** it is beatable but strong. An idle player loses every time. A perfect-tracking bot wins about 100%. Simulated humans with a 0.15 s reaction time won 9 of 40, and slower ones won 0 of 40. If you want an easier opponent, lower `AI_SPEED` in `src/game.js`.
- **Feel:** the paddle moves at about 430 px/s with no lag. The ball starts at 340 px/s and speeds up 6% per paddle hit, so rallies of 12–21 hits are reachable.
- **Not checked:** sound. I ran headless, so I could not hear it. It fired without errors.
- **Control quirk:** Enter on the result screen is ignored for the first 0.6 s, which is by design.

I played with a script that steers the paddle, so the feel notes come from measured numbers rather than a human hand.

comments.body:
QA result: **no defects reproduced; R1–R8 all pass** on the delivery as it now stands: game-developer@e2970e952cdb0273617ac41c547a0d3cb3c81502 (build-3) + artist@b2daa7038200d3e5c5c85a5bae323c40fafb319b. Script `qa/check.py`; logs, JSON and screenshots in `qa/build3/` (and `qa/build1/`, logs `qa/build3_*.log`).

Method: headless Chromium (Playwright), real keyboard events, served over plain `http.server` and opened from `file://`; `window.pong` is read only to observe state.

| Req | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R1 browser, no build/network | PASS | Loads from both file:// and static server; zero console errors/warnings, zero failed or 4xx requests; canvas fits 1920x1080, 640x400, 420x800 |
| R2 Pong | PASS | Ball stayed inside top/bottom walls over a 12 s sample; scoring counted exactly one point at a time in every match (score histories in logs); play resumes after each point |
| R3 vs computer | PASS | Idle player loses 0–5 every time (computer can win; 5 matches). Tracking bot beat it 5–1, 5–0, 5–1 on the earlier delivery, so the computer is beatable and also scores |
| R4 keyboard | PASS | ArrowUp/Down and W/S each move the paddle; clamps exactly at top (0) and bottom (420); Up+Down together = no drift; stops on key release; key-mashing causes no errors |
| R5 first to 5 | PASS | Matches end at 5 with the other side below 5; ball and score frozen for 2.5 s afterwards; paddle input ignored |
| R6 title | PASS | Shown on load; names game, controls (W/S, arrows, P, M) and "PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO START"; Enter/Space start, other keys (arrows, A, X, Esc, P) don't. Build 3 title has no centre line through the text (`qa/build3/http_title.png`) |
| R7 score in play | PASS | YOU/CPU scores shown during play and update per point (`*_play_serve.png`, `paused.png`) |
| R8 win screen + play again | PASS | "COMPUTER WINS"/"YOU WIN!" with final score and "PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN" (`gameover_with_prompt.png`); Space, Enter and click each restart a fresh 0–0 match, repeated 3 times in a row; Esc returns to title and Enter starts again |

Edge cases also passing: pause (P) freezes ball and paddles even with keys held; window blur pauses; Enter during play does nothing; finishing a match with a key held is fine.

Notes (observations, not defects): the win-screen prompt appears and accepts input only after 0.6 s (a keypress within that window is ignored by design); the score digits are dimmed under the pause/win overlay but readable; I did not judge audio by ear, only that all sounds load with no errors.

Not yet in: on build 3 the tracking-bot matches (`qa/build3_matches.log`) are still running; their rules code is unchanged from the build I already passed (build 3 only changed centre-line drawing in `src/main.js`), and I'll only reopen this if they show something.
